title: BTS Close Argentina Run in La Plata, Promise to Return
detail: BTS ended their three-night La Plata stay before 60,000+ fans with surprise songs 'Lost' and 'Cypher Pt. 4'. All seven members wore Argentina national team jerseys and gaucho sashes; J-Hope hinted at a return and V said he believed fans would see them soon. Jungkook said a leg pain limited his enjoyment of the show. The concert was also broadcast live to cinemas abroad. Crowd estimates for the run are unconfirmed by the organizer.
